item.title: Player frustrated by Augusta snub
item.description: Three-time Masters champion Gary Player has expressed his disappointment at being denied permission to play a fourball at Augusta National Golf Club with his grandsons.

item.title: DeChambeau, Rahm break clear in Adelaide
item.description: Star duo Job Rahm and Bryson DeChambeau lead by five shots and will decide LIV Golf’s marquee regular-season event in a direct showdown.

item.title: Sattelkau chasing back-to-back titles
item.description: Germany’s Celina Sattelkau takes a three-stroke lead into Sunday’s final round of the NTT DATA Ladies’ Pro-Am.

item.title: Els brings sunshine on cloudy Fancourt day
item.description: MJ Daffue surged to 13 under with a sparkling 64 to lead the NTT Data Men’s Pro-Am at Fancourt, while Ernie Els rolled back the years.

item.title: Bhatia grabs lead at breezy Pebble Beach
item.description: Akshay Bhatia birdied six of his first seven holes on the way to a four-under 68 to seize a two-shot lead after Saturday’s third round of the PGA Tour's Pebble Beach Pro-Am.

item.title: Emotional Kim captures maiden LIV title
item.description: An "overwhelmed" Anthony Kim outplayed Jon Rahm to win LIV Golf Adelaide on Sunday and complete an amazing redemption story.

item.title: Louis: LIV field rivals Million Dollar glory days
item.description: Louis Oosthuizen believes next month’s LIV Golf stop at Steyn City will showcase one of the strongest international fields seen in South Africa in more than two decades.

item.title: Sattelkau wins back-to-back on Sunshine Ladies Tour
item.description: Germany’s Celina Sattelkau claimed a convincing five-stroke victory in the NTT Data Ladies’ Pro-Am at The Links at Fancourt on Sunday.

item.title: Daffue wins NTT Data Pro-Am in style
item.description: South African MJ Daffue eagled the last to claim an emotional victory in the NTT Data Pro-Am at Fancourt on Sunday.

item.title: Morikawa holds off Scheffler to end trophy drought
item.description: Collin Morikawa claimed a tense victory at the Pebble Beach Pro-Am in California on Sunday, fending off a final-day charge by world No 1 Scottie Scheffler.
